description: C4 (last-resort severity escalation, run ONLY if C3 fails its gate). Kills two movements at the busiest central approach (W->E through and W->left) while the right-turn lane (road_1_2_0_0) still trickles -- a real multi-lane accident class, but a stronger claim to defend, hence last resort. Same duration/position as C2 so the escalation is purely 'one lane -> two lanes'. Gate is unchanged: MP delta-ATT vs the clean seed spread.
